answer: Each epoch the deposit tide closes an hour before the challenge words appear: every account must lock 10 POA in escrow while blind to what gets graded. The atlas, a public index of locked bonds, freezes then, so nobody can fund only the fakes that later score. 1,000 sybils idle 10,000 POA per round, and any bond tied to a duplicate or panel-matched answer is slashed. Colluders cannot share one deposit, since a bond maps to a single address. Honest agents get it back; veterans drop to the willow tier, a 2 POA lock that snaps back to 10 after a slash.
